measure_note: MARGINAL = the effect of ONE substitution, measured against the netlist the candidate was derived from; CUMULATIVE = the effect against the circuit baseline netlist.  The two are never compared with each other.

ideal_cumulative_basis.note: the circuit-baseline ideal WNS per circuit, read from the ledger as the reference of the iteration-1 trials (whose base netlist hash IS the circuit baseline netlist); the cumulative reading subtracts THIS, while the marginal reading subtracts the iteration base

placed_sources_note: derived from netlist_consistency.json: the placed stage must measure the same netlist as the routed label, and s713's routed labels come from the tie-cell repaired batch
common_subset_note: the three stages may cover different candidate sets (the placed stage is a separate run batch), so the stage-to-stage comparison is made on the candidates that carry all three stages
caveat: the placed stage uses the placement parasitic model and the routed stage the global-routing model, so "routed - placed" mixes the physical stage change with the change of the estimation model; it is not a pure routing penalty.
